name: Singapore no-fly zones

layers.label: NParks park or nature reserve
layers.summary: Drones are not allowed in this park or nature reserve (NParks).

layers.label: Within 5 km of an aerodrome
layers.summary: Within 5 km of an aerodrome: a no-fly zone for unmanned aircraft without a CAAS permit.

layers.label: Protected area (Air Navigation Act)
layers.summary: Protected area under the Air Navigation Act: a no-fly zone for unmanned aircraft without a CAAS permit.

layers.label: Danger area
layers.summary: Danger area: flying unmanned aircraft is not allowed without a CAAS permit.

layers.label: Restricted area
layers.summary: Restricted area: unauthorised aerial activity is not allowed (see the height limit).

layers.label: Prohibited area
layers.summary: Prohibited area: flying unmanned aircraft is not allowed.

layers.label: UA flying area (open use)
layers.summary: A CAAS unmanned aircraft flying area, where flying is allowed under the area's rules.

layers.label: UA flying area (community-led)
layers.summary: A community-led CAAS unmanned aircraft flying area: contact the club before flying.

source.authority: CAAS, MHA and NParks, as published on OneMap
